understanding: Chapters 2-3 of a 5-chapter OKO VLM rollout. Ch.2: wire the already-built GeminiVlmProvider into build_vlm() with a config-or-default model of gemini-2.5-flash, and point both example.yaml and live-webcam.yaml vlm blocks at the gemini provider. Ch.3: make the VlmGate fire only for person_entered_zone/animal_entered_zone — purely by supplying a VlmGateConfig profile that neutralizes the risk/normality/risk_level branches (event_types=person/animal, risk_levels=(), min_risk_score=1.01, max_normality_score=-0.01), with no edit to _trigger_reason — and broaden _class_is_animal to the full COCO animal set. This is an assembly task; the gate's four-branch OR and the provider's deferred-I/O design already make every requirement reachable via config + small additive edits.
summary: Add a `gemini` branch to build_vlm mirroring the existing http-json branch, reusing DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODEL so 'strictly gemini-2.5-flash' has one source of truth and construction stays network-free (transport is only invoked in query()). Flip both yaml vlm blocks to {provider: gemini, model: gemini-2.5-flash, api_key_env: GEMINI_API_KEY, timeout_seconds: 15} — all valid VlmConfig fields under extra='forbid'. Implement person/animal-only gating entirely through a VlmGateConfig profile (recommended: extract it as a named, importable profile in gate.py for Ch.4 live wiring) and extend _class_is_animal to a named frozenset {animal, cat, dog, bird, horse, sheep, cow, elephant, bear, zebra, giraffe}. Add tests in the existing suites: factory gemini test (test_providers.py), config validity (test_config.py), and the trigger matrix (test_vlm_gate.py). Note that test_example_config_drives_providers already couples the config+factory edits, so they must land together.

decision_atoms.statement: Add a `provider == 'gemini'` branch to build_vlm that returns GeminiVlmProvider(model=config.model or DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODEL, api_key_env=config.api_key_env or 'GEMINI_API_KEY', timeout_seconds=config.timeout_seconds), importing both the class and the DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODEL constant from oko.providers.gemini_vlm.
decision_atoms.reason: Mirrors the existing http-json branch shape; VlmConfig.model/api_key_env default to '' so the `or` fallbacks engage; reusing DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODEL gives one source of truth for the 'strictly gemini-2.5-flash' constraint instead of a second hardcoded literal in the factory.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Factory becomes coupled to a provider-module constant, but it already imports the provider class, so the extra coupling is negligible versus the drift risk of duplicating the model string.

decision_atoms.statement: Implement person/animal-only triggering with no change to _trigger_reason or any gate.py logic — only via a VlmGateConfig with event_types=('person_entered_zone','animal_entered_zone'), risk_levels=(), min_risk_score=1.01, max_normality_score=-0.01.
decision_atoms.reason: _trigger_reason already evaluates four OR branches against config; risk_levels=() never matches, 1.01 > any in-range risk_score, -0.01 < any in-range normality_score, leaving event_type membership as the sole live branch. This satisfies the 'via config, not by editing _trigger_reason' constraint exactly.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: The 1.01/-0.01 sentinels rely on scores being bounded to [0,1]; they read as a hack rather than an explicit 'event_types_only' switch, but they require zero production-code change and are guarded by the trigger-matrix test.

decision_atoms.statement: Extract the person/animal-only config as a named, importable profile in src/oko/vlm/gate.py (module constant PERSON_ANIMAL_ONLY_GATE_CONFIG or a VlmGateConfig.person_animal_only() classmethod) and import it in the test, rather than inlining it only in tests/test_vlm_gate.py.
decision_atoms.reason: Chapter 4 ('проводка в live + мульти-кадр') will need exactly this gate profile; a single definition prevents the test and live wiring from drifting, and VlmGateConfig is a frozen dataclass so the shared instance is safe.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Adds a small public API surface now exercised only by tests until Ch.4; the strictly-minimal reading of the task only requires inline construction in the test.

decision_atoms.statement: Broaden _class_is_animal to a module-level frozenset _COCO_ANIMAL_CLASSES = {animal, cat, dog, bird, horse, sheep, cow, elephant, bear, zebra, giraffe}, keeping the generic 'animal' sentinel.
decision_atoms.reason: Additive change that preserves existing animal/cat/dog/bird behavior, satisfies the explicit COCO list, and a named constant documents intent (the predicate also feeds the danger-zone risk boost in _zone_event). Grep confirms no builder test asserts these classes are non-animals.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: More detected classes now route to ANIMAL_ENTERED_ZONE and receive the danger-zone risk bump — this is the intended product behavior but does change classification/scoring for horse/bear/etc.

decision_atoms.statement: Set both configs/example.yaml and configs/live-webcam.yaml vlm blocks to {provider: gemini, model: gemini-2.5-flash, api_key_env: GEMINI_API_KEY, timeout_seconds: 15}.
decision_atoms.reason: All four keys are valid VlmConfig fields, so extra='forbid' validation passes; timeout 15 coerces to float. The existing test_example_config_drives_providers will then build a GeminiVlmProvider through the new branch and still assert isinstance VlmProvider, doubling as a config↔factory consistency check.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Shipping the config edit without the factory branch makes test_example_config_drives_providers raise ValueError; the two Ch.2 parts must land together.

decision_atoms.statement: Place new tests in the existing suites: gemini factory test in tests/test_providers.py (assert GeminiVlmProvider, model == 'gemini-2.5-flash', construction makes no network call), config-validity assertions in tests/test_config.py, and the trigger matrix in tests/test_vlm_gate.py.
decision_atoms.reason: Keeps test locality consistent with the current layout (build_vlm tests already live in test_providers.py; from_yaml/load_config tests in test_config.py), and existing fixtures/helpers can be reused.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: None material; spreads the three sub-features across three files but each lands beside its peers.

assumptions: risk_score and normality_score are bounded to [0,1] for all events (builder clamps via max/min), so min_risk_score=1.01 and max_normality_score=-0.01 reliably neutralize those two branches.

Chapter 1's GeminiVlmProvider is already merged and only touches the network inside query() (its __init__ merely validates and stores attributes and sets self._transport = transport or _post_json), so 'no network at construction' needs no additional code.
No existing builder test asserts that horse/cow/bear/elephant/sheep/zebra/giraffe are non-animals (confirmed by grep), so extending _class_is_animal will not break test_event_builder.py.

Config-load tests do not pin example.yaml or live-webcam.yaml vlm.provider to a specific value (test_valid_example_yaml_loads checks only detector; test_live_webcam checks detector+camera; the http-json assertion is against live-template.yaml), so retargeting their vlm blocks to gemini is safe.
The named gate profile is intended for reuse by Chapter 4's live wiring, justifying defining it in gate.py now rather than only in the test.

risks.risk: Extending _class_is_animal reroutes newly-covered classes to ANIMAL_ENTERED_ZONE and applies the danger-zone risk boost elsewhere in EventBuilder, potentially shifting event scores/types for those classes.
risks.mitigation: Run the full pytest suite; grep already shows no builder test relies on these classes being non-animal; this is the intended product behavior, so update any incidental assertion if one surfaces.

risks.risk: The config edits and the factory branch are coupled by test_example_config_drives_providers — landing the yaml change without the gemini branch turns that test into a ValueError failure.
risks.mitigation: Land both Chapter-2 deliverables in the same change; keep the existing unknown-provider test (provider='openai' -> ValueError) intact to prove only known providers resolve.

risks.risk: min_risk_score=1.01 / max_normality_score=-0.01 are sentinel values that silently stop neutralizing if event scores ever exceed [0,1].
risks.mitigation: Rely on the documented score clamping; add the high-risk-only -> should_query False case (and ideally a high-risk camera_offline -> False) to the matrix test so any regression in neutralization is caught.

risks.risk: Default-model drift: the factory and the provider could disagree on the default model, or a future edit could point at gemini-pro / gemini-3-flash, violating the strict-model constraint.
risks.mitigation: Reuse DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODEL in the factory (single source), pin gemini-2.5-flash in both yamls, and assert the exact model string in the factory and config tests.

minimal_version: Add the `gemini` branch to build_vlm (model=config.model or DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODEL, api_key_env=config.api_key_env or 'GEMINI_API_KEY', timeout_seconds=config.timeout_seconds) plus the import. Update both configs/example.yaml and configs/live-webcam.yaml vlm blocks to {provider: gemini, model: gemini-2.5-flash, api_key_env: GEMINI_API_KEY, timeout_seconds: 15}. Extend the _class_is_animal set with the ten COCO classes. In tests/test_vlm_gate.py construct the VlmGateConfig profile inline and assert the matrix (person_entered_zone -> True, animal_entered_zone -> True, camera_offline/object_appeared/high-risk-only -> False); add a factory test asserting isinstance GeminiVlmProvider, model == 'gemini-2.5-flash', and that construction makes no network call; add a config-validity assertion. No new public API. Run pytest to green.
advanced_version: All of minimal, plus: extract a named importable profile (VlmGateConfig.person_animal_only() classmethod or PERSON_ANIMAL_ONLY_GATE_CONFIG constant) in gate.py and import it from the test so Chapter 4's live wiring reuses one definition; lift the animal set into a named _COCO_ANIMAL_CLASSES frozenset; strengthen the gate test to actually prove neutralization (a high-risk camera_offline and a low-normality non-person event both stay should_query False); reuse DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODEL in the factory and assert the exact model string and provider name in both the factory and config tests; add a parametrized test driving all ten COCO classes through _class_is_animal / the event builder's ANIMAL_ENTERED_ZONE routing.
